articles.title_en: Russians were told how to survive a night in the forest with the help of a fire and spruce branches
articles.lead_en: To do this, you need to dig a shallow hole the length of a man, light a fire in it for several hours, remove the coals, and make a flooring of dry earth and grass or spruce branches on top, said search and rescuer Yana Vilchinskaya

articles.lead_raw: Для этого нужно выкопать неглубокую яму длиной в человеческий рост, разжечь в ней огонь на несколько часов, вынуть угли, а сверху сделать настил из сухой земли и травы или еловых веток, сообщила поисковик-спасатель Яна Вильчинская

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike port in southern Russia, injuring 2 and sparking fire
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck the port of Taman in Krasnodar Krai overnight on May 13, the regional operational headquarters reported. Debris from a downed drone, it said, “fell on the grounds of one of the facilities in the village of Volna in the Temryuk district” — where the port is located — starting a fire at the facility, which the headquarters did not name.
